replication.target_description: Current project, Online protocol after preregistered exclusions: initial offer of chips to angry versus happy recipients, all with low consequences of rejection. Table 2 standardized angry-minus-happy difference; Table 4 within-protocol emotion contrast with random intercept for testing site.

n.sample_role: Participants included in the post-exclusion target protocol analysis; all received low-consequences instructions. Not recruitment total, sites, or testing groups.
n.exclusions: 193 subjects (64%) excluded from the online protocol by preregistered criteria; final 108. Criteria: knowledge of the ultimatum game, doubt that partner was real, familiarity with other subjects, and failed manipulation check. Five additional enrolled subjects could not be tested source-wide; allocation unspecified.

notes:
Original locator p.10 corresponds to the published version; supplied accepted manuscript places the matching result on p.31. Original low-consequence subgroup n is not established from the full experiment total. Replication d is printed in Table 2, with direction angry minus happy; the p and Wald z are the authors' protocol-specific mixed-effects emotion test in Table 4 on the same post-exclusion target contrast, parameterized happy minus angry. Table 2 does not print a separate p for an unadjusted standardized mean difference. Success label follows authors' protocol-specific narrative, which also states all three effects were in the original direction and substantially smaller than the original. Full primary publisher PDF was accessible through the web tool after direct terminal retrieval returned 403; no retry of that terminal route.
Completion source review (n_r): Explicit post-exclusion participants remaining for inclusion, assigned by named protocol; all participants received low-consequence instructions. 193 subjects (64%) excluded from the online protocol by preregistered criteria; final 108. Criteria: knowledge of the ultimatum game, doubt that partner was real, familiarity with other subjects, and failed manipulation check. Five additional enrolled subjects could not be tested source-wide; allocation unspecified.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Printed Cohen’s d in named Current project protocol row, after exclusions; sign and precision preserved. No conversion.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Printed exact p for Happy condition in named protocol-specific Table 4 model, same post-exclusion sample/outcome/emotion contrast as Table 2; random intercept of testing site. Descriptive d and mixed-model inferential test are explicitly distinguished in notes.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors define successful replication and explicitly state that only the revised protocol provided statistically significant support for the original effect; mapped to failed for Online. All protocols had the original direction.
